preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 1 and 300,000, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and the number of cities minus 1, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 300,000, inclusive.
The cities are numbered from 1 to n.
There is at most one road between any two cities.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == length of the longest path in the region containing city xi for event 1 xi
postconditions.description: The output for each event of the first type is the length of the longest path in the region containing city xi.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == length of the longest path in the merged region after event 2 xi yi
postconditions.description: The output for each event of the second type is the length of the longest path in the merged region after merging the region containing city xi with the region containing city yi.
